Based on my exploration of the token IR, component definitions, and custom-component generation patterns, here are the verified findings:

## Token Names for Missing Banner Styles

### Alert Default Info Icon
- **Icon token:** `--instui-icon-info` 
- **Icon sizing:** Hardcoded `1.125rem` (CSS mask-size in alert.css, line 120)
- **Icon background:** `--instui-component-alert-info-icon-background`
- **Default alert sets:** `--pantoken-alert-glyph: var(--instui-icon-info)` and `--pantoken-alert-icon-bg: var(--instui-component-alert-info-icon-background)`

### Heading/TitleCard Mappings
Available tokens (verified in [heading.css](formats/components/src/components/heading/heading.css#L77-L91)):
- **Mini card:** `--instui-component-heading-title-card-mini-font-size` (`1rem`), `--instui-component-heading-title-card-mini-font-weight` (`700`)
- **Regular card:** `--instui-component-heading-title-card-regular-font-size` (`1.25rem`), `--instui-component-heading-title-card-regular-font-weight` (`700`)
- **CSS selector:** `.pfx-heading.-variant-title-card-mini` or `.pfx-heading.-variant-title-card-regular`

### Text/ContentSmall & Semantic FontSize/TextBase Mappings  
Verified tokens (from [text.css](formats/components/src/components/text/text.css#L146-L149) and [button.css](formats/components/src/components/button/button.css#L50)):
- **Small content:** `--instui-component-text-content-small-font-size` (`0.875rem`), `--instui-component-text-content-small-font-weight` (`400`), `--instui-component-text-content-small-line-height` (`150%`)
- **Text base line-height:** `--instui-line-height-standalone-text-base` (`1rem`)
- **CSS selector:** `.pfx-text.-variant-content-small`

### Icon Sizing & Spacing Values
- **Icon default mask size:** `1.125rem` (hardcoded in mask declarations, not tokenized)
- **Default spacing:** `--instui-spacing-space-xs` (`0.25rem`) — used for button icon/label gap
- **Alert icon bar width:** `2.5rem` (hardcoded, not tokenized)
- **Close button positioning uses:** `var(--instui-spacing-space-xs)` for alert top/end insets

### Alert Close Button Position Tokens
Verified tokens (from [alert.css](formats/components/src/components/alert/alert.css#L88) and banner.css):
- `--instui-component-alert-close-button-margin-top`
- `--instui-component-alert-close-button-margin-right`
- **Banner equivalents:** `--instui-component-banner-close-button-margin-top` (`0.5rem`), `--instui-component-banner-close-button-margin-right` (`0.5rem`)
- **Default button height:** `--instui-component-base-button-small-height` (`2rem`) for unsized close buttons in alerts

### 'onColorPrimary' Button Token Context
Found in [button.css](formats/components/src/components/button/button.css#L148-L156) — these tokens apply to buttons on colored backgrounds:
- `--instui-component-base-button-primary-on-color-hover-border-color` (`#D5E2F6`)
- `--instui-component-base-button-primary-on-color-active-border-color` (`#B6CCEA`)
- **Used in:** `.pfx-button.-color-primary-inverse:hover` and `:active` states
- **Meaning:** "On-color" = styled for placement on a colored/inverse background (dark mode), distinct from `primary-inverse-background`

## Custom-Components Source & Generation Pattern

**Source location:** [plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/](plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/) (banner, card, agent-shell)

**Generation pattern:**
- Each component follows: `<name>/index.ts` + `<name>/<name>.css`
- `index.ts` imports from `generated/component-styles.ts` and uses `SENTINEL` replacement for prefix (dogfooding the `definePlugin` pattern from AGENTS.md)
- Factory function: `export function bannerRules(prefix = "instui-"): string { return bannerRaw.replaceAll(SENTINEL, prefix); }`

**Docs/generation/demos:**
- ✅ **Auto-generated:** CSS API docs at `/docs/api/css/{banner,card,agent-shell}.md` are generated by [build-css-api.ts](docs/scripts/build-css-api.ts) from JSDoc in `.css` files
- ✅ **No source edits required:** Docs hook into `@cssdoc/typedoc`'s `emitCssApi` which parses CSS `@component` docblocks
- ✅ **Demos:** Staged into `public/demos/` by [demos.ts](docs/scripts/demos.ts); example blocks in CSS docstrings render automatically

**Requirement that cannot be directly satisfied by CSS alone:**
- ⚠️ **Icon rendering in alert variants** — default info/success/warning/danger icons rely on token-based glyph URLs (`--instui-icon-info`, etc.) which are SVG `url()` values; custom icons via `-icon-<name>` require JavaScript to resolve icon names to URLs, or CSS class painter logic (markup must include the icon as a separate element or the component system must handle icon injection)

The design can reuse `--instui-icon-info`, heading and text component tokens, and the alert’s absolute close-button pattern; the main contract choice is the banner’s public child structure. I need your decision on that and on how broadly “onColorPrimary” applies before I lock the plan.
